description: DPI button setter (setDPIButton) uses command byte 0x63 (99 decimal). Param 'enabled' encoded as bool at offset 1. Body is 5 zero bytes (offsets 2-6). Request checksum is ff-minus-sum8 over offsets 0..7, written at offset 7. Source: decompiled/mouseApi.py setDPIButton (line 139). Getter 0xE3 returns res[1] parsed as bool (parsers.json dpi-button). AM35_EVIDENCE §5 warns value 18 (0x18) has special encoding in the AM35 protocol; that warning does not apply to Protocol A where the byte is a plain bool switch.
